divisions.tagline: A 90-day plan to turn HR into a business enabler. The deck has no people figures yet; the first HR dashboard is due by 3 November (A16).

breakdowns.title: 90-day roadmap

rows.label: 0-30 days: HR data clean-up; organisation/manpower mapping; critical vacancies; policy & process gap assessment
31-60 days: KRA/KPI framework; recruitment scorecards; training calendar; HR dashboard v1
61-90 days: performance review cycle; competency framework; engagement/R&R initiatives; succession planning for critical roles

breakdowns.source: Marikar Group HR-HOD Meeting Presentation Oct 2026, slide 13

breakdowns.title: Metrics proposed for the monthly HR dashboard
breakdowns.source: Marikar Group HR-HOD Meeting Presentation Oct 2026, slide 11

highlights: HR repositioned 'from support function to business enabler' with 5 pillars: Manpower, Performance, Capability, Culture, Governance (HR designs the system, HODs own the outcome).
Performance architecture: JD/KRAs -> monthly/quarterly KPIs with weightage -> monthly 1:1 and quarterly review -> coaching/recognition/PIP.
30-60-90 day onboarding plan for critical roles; candidate scorecards; competency-based selection.
concerns: Deck identifies gaps in manpower deployment, performance management (activity reporting rather than KPIs), manager effectiveness, recruitment speed/quality, training, engagement/retention and HR governance.
No people data currently presented - HR MIS / single source of people data still to be built.
actions: Execute 90-day roadmap (visibility -> accountability -> action).

Seven asks of HODs: own manpower productivity, set KRAs/KPIs, monthly performance reviews, justify manpower requests, ensure training application, recognise/address performance, share people data on time.
Per HOD meeting context (not stated in the deck): JDs and KPIs for every role, LMS, GPTW readiness, execution efficiency 3/10 -> 8/10 by 31 Mar 2027.
gaps: HR deck contains no headcount, attrition, vacancy, absenteeism or manpower-cost numbers - all HR KPI values are null.
Execution-efficiency score (3/10 -> 8/10), LMS and GPTW targets are from meeting context only, not in the file; no dated milestones beyond the 0-30/31-60/61-90 day buckets.
Only division-level headcount found is OAIP team strength (in CANON breakdowns).
